text: Boolos proved that plural logic is expressively equivalent to which system, via the translation X ↦ xx and X(t) ↦ t ≺ xx?
choices: Full second-order logic (with relation variables), with no further assumptions
explanation: The translation maps each monadic second-order variable X to a plural variable xx and each atom X(t) to t ≺ xx, giving equivalence with MONADIC second-order logic. Full second-order logic (quantifying over relations) is reached only with an added pairing function, not automatically; and plural logic is meant to be ontologically far weaker than ZF, not equivalent to it.
